description: This file defines a database migration class for transitioning the database schema from version 9 to 10 in an Android app, specifically adding an 'EXCERPT' column to the 'NOTES' table and populating it using existing note data.

classes.name: Migration_9_10
classes.description: A migration class that alters the database schema to add an 'EXCERPT' column to the 'NOTES' table and populates it based on existing note content.

methods.name: Migration_9_10
